title.en: The Gram Sabha and village meetings

text.en:
In Meena's village everyone over 18 gathered under the banyan tree to discuss a new well.
"This meeting is the Gram Sabha," said the sarpanch.

The Gram Sabha is a meeting of all the adult voters of a village. It discusses plans, budgets and problems of the village.
It is the base of democracy because every adult can speak and vote on local decisions.
The Gram Sabha meets regularly and checks the work of the Gram Panchayat. Women and people of all communities take part.

problem.en: Who can attend the Gram Sabha?

text.en: All adult voters of the village.
They discuss and decide village issues.

prompt.en: A friend says only the sarpanch can speak at the Gram Sabha. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: That is the point of grassroots democracy.

points.en: The Gram Sabha is the village meeting.
